# Supporting tools

Keep measurement orchestration outside the Rust processing and GUI layers. Do not install, launch native pointer runs or execute GPU-heavy measurements without owner coordination. Preserve raw evidence and stop only tool-owned processes.

<!-- INDEX:START -->

### Directories

- **[classic/](./classic/AGENTS.md)** Classic experiment tools capture bounded reference implementation fixtures for signed processing operations.
- **[help-examples/](./help-examples/AGENTS.md)** Python tooling explicitly renders manifest-driven help comparisons from the source cache maintained by Cargo.
- **[profiling/](./profiling/AGENTS.md)** Profiling tools record owned native sessions, summarize shared JSON reports, and flag known overlapping workloads.

### Source files

- **[color_field_report.py](./color_field_report.py)** Build a private, color-managed, toggleable report from saved-edit GPU comparisons.
- **[generate_signed_node_fixtures.py](./generate_signed_node_fixtures.py)** Generate bounded native fixtures for signed chroma and direct root/detail operations.
